description: Use this when the person asks for lessons, a board to rent or a surf shop near a spot. kind keeps to one: school, rental or shop. Not for the waves: use get_surf_forecast. Answers surf schools, board rentals and surf shops within 2 km of a spot, each with its name, kind, distance, address and link where known, from Apple Maps' places.

spot.description: a surf spot's id as search_surf_spots or list_surf_spots_near show it, or its name (Ericeira, Supertubos, Hossegor)
